mira_oncall: Quick overnight handoff — what I did / blockers / next steps

• What I did: scaled embed-ingest workers in eu-west1 (5 -> 12), enabled short-term read-fallback for cache hits, restarted ingest-queuer (graceful). Observed tail latencies go down from ~3s to ~700ms for queued embeds. Ran smoke on a couple of noisy tenants.

• Ongoing incidents: 1) embed-ingest backlog causing delayed embeddings (~5–10m tail for some requests). Alerts: embed.ingest.queue_depth > 500 for >5m. 2) kvcache thrash on shared-host-07 leading to intermittent 504s for small-chat traffic (not high error rate, but noticeable p95 latency spikes).

• Mitigations applied: scaled workers, enabled fallback-to-cached-embedding path (tiered lookup) for requests older than 2m, bumped ingest pod CPU request by 0.5, applied a soft eviction tweak to kvcache (eviction_soft_limit=0.75) and enabled per-tenant circuit-breaker for tenants with >10% cache miss.

• Blockers / unknowns: root cause of kvcache thrash unclear — could be a noisy tenant pattern (large sequential keys) or underlying disk I/O on shared-host-07. Need deeper io-stats and tenant request traces. Also seeing a small elevation in egress to S3 during backfill jobs (possible contributor).

• Next steps (action items):
  - infra-ana: grab iostat/blkparse for shared-host-07 and confirm whether disk stalls correlate (ETA: +30m).
  - jules_sre: please create an incident ticket (INC-embed-1769) and start a timeline; assign postmortem after stabilization.
  - sam_engineering: please hold canary rollout of eviction-policy-v2 until we validate traces (recommend AM after logs ingested).
  - I'll leave the ingest autoscaling policy open +15% headroom for next 2 hours, then scale down if stable.

Useful snippets / quick checks:
```
# basic queue depth query
sum(queue_depth) by (region, service) > 500
```

Fallback toggle: `echo enable_fallback=true | ./run-toggle --service=embed-ingest`

Status: no pager in last 40m, rate of 5xx peaked ~01:12 UTC, currently trending down. Handing to @sam for morning follow-up. :thumbsup:

---

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: infra/embed-ingest @ commit abcdef1 (2026-03-17T01:05Z). No failures reported by deploy-checker.

sam_engineering: Ack — thanks Mira. Can you drop the runbook link for the embed-ingest queue runbook? Also what tenants were the noisy ones you saw (just so we can isolate)? :eyes:

mira_oncall: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-ingest-queue. Noisy tenants: tenant-phi and tenant-qa03 (both are large batch backfills). I left a note in the runbook section "temporary backfill exemptions".

jules_sre: Taking INC-embed-1769. I'll start timeline + collect logs. Please add any zips of /var/log/embed-ingest/*.log.gz to the ticket — Mira, did you collect those or should I pull from s3-logs?

infra-ana: I'm pulling iostat and dstat now for shared-host-07, will upload to the incident ticket. Initial glance shows brief bursts of >1000 iops coincident with the spikes. I'm also looking at S3 egress metrics to see backfill correlation.

mira_oncall: I grabbed a filtered log for tenant-phi and uploaded a 20MB gzip to s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-embed-1769/phi-sample-01.log.gz — added link in the ticket. Also left a short stacktrace clip for one of the 504s in the ticket.

sam_engineering: OK will wait on canary. Also FYI there's one PR waiting review that may help kvcache memory pressure: PR #4826 (kv eviction heuristics). I'll try to review before EOD my side.

jules_sre: If we see another spike, enable tenant-level isolation for tenant-phi (hotfix flag: `tenant_isolate=on`) — that's safe to flip and has been used before.

mira_oncall: noted. I'm toggling `enable_fallback=true` for the next 90m and leaving a comment in the incident ticket about expected behavior. Handing to @sam — feel free to page me if anything regresses. :wave:

sam_engineering: Got it — taking over. I'll coordinate the canary tomorrow AM and loop in platform for a follow-up resize if infra-ana confirms disk stalls. Thanks Mira. :thumbsup:
